_note: Timed by the group (Amna, Sarita, Subhan) with a stopwatch on sample controls; results matched the planning estimates, so those values are kept.

manual.basis: Group timing of manual mapping on sample controls averaged about 20 minutes per control across seven frameworks (235 requirements); requirement status and gap ranking for all 235 requirements about 150 minutes.
manual.description: Analyst reads each control, searches framework catalogs, records mappings, then works out requirement coverage by hand

ai_assisted.basis: Group timing of reviewing AI suggestions: about 1 minute per suggestion, about 3 suggestions per control (74 suggestions for 25 controls).
ai_assisted.description: Analyst reviews and approves each AI suggested mapping; AI runtime is measured automatically from the run log
